description: This file defines the 'Session' class within the 'cuttlefish::confui' namespace, representing a confirmation UI session with methods for managing session state, rendering dialogs, handling transitions, and user interactions. It includes necessary headers, external dependencies, and class member declarations relevant to session management in a UI confirmation context.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a confirmation UI session managing state transitions, rendering, and user interactions within the 'cuttlefish::confui' namespace.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the session.

methods.name: Transition
methods.description: Handles state transitions based on input and messages.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Transitions the session to a suspended state.

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Restores the session to a previous state.

methods.name: UserAbort
methods.description: Handles user-initiated aborts, notifying the guest.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the session is currently suspended.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the session.

methods.name: IsConfirm
methods.description: Determines if a given coordinate is within a confirm button.

methods.name: IsCancel
methods.description: Determines if a given coordinate is within a cancel button.

methods.name: IsReadyForUserInput
methods.description: Checks if the session is ready to accept user input.

methods.name: RenderDialog
methods.description: Creates and renders a dialog frame on the webRTC client.

methods.name: HandleInit
methods.description: Handles the initial state transition logic.

methods.name: HandleWaitStop
methods.description: Handles transition logic when waiting to stop.

methods.name: HandleInSession
methods.description: Handles transition logic during an active session.

methods.name: ReportErrorToHal
methods.description: Reports an error to HAL and resets FSM.
